es.title: Plata
es.extract: La plata es un elemento químico de número atómico 47 situado en el grupo 11 de la tabla periódica de los elementos. Su símbolo es Ag. Es un metal noble, de transición, de color gris medio, brillante, blando, dúctil y maleable.

en.title: Silver
en.extract: Silver is a chemical element; it has symbol Ag and atomic number 47. A soft, white, lustrous transition metal, it exhibits the highest electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity and reflectivity of any metal. Silver is found in the Earth's crust in the pure, free elemental form, as an alloy with gold (electrum) and other metals, and in minerals such as acanthite, argentite and chlorargyrite. Most silver is recovered as a byproduct of lead–zinc, copper and gold mining and refining.
